top_signals.title: Binance hit by record $6.3 billion crypto hack, scrambles to freeze funds
top_signals.summary: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, confirmed Thursday that it had been hacked in a $6.3 billion cyber heist that blockchain investigators are blaming on North Korea.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
